abbreviation.description: Short plant code of 2 to 6 uppercase letters or digits, unique, e.g. 'LOH'. Prefix of asset, tool and work order IDs; the plants go by it in daily use. Null = not set yet.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the plant, e.g. 'Europe/Berlin' (one zone for all of Europe); dates and times of the plant are shown in it. Null = not set yet.

sapPlants.description: SAP system and plant assignments; each pair belongs to at most one platform plant.

aliases.description: Codes and names other systems use for this plant, e.g. in group finance reports ('ABC', 'Example Works'). Matched case- and accent-insensitively; each alias belongs to at most one plant. data-sync links reporting extracts through them.

currency.description: Local (company-code) currency, ISO 4217, e.g. 'EUR'; amounts reported in local currency are converted with fx_rates. Null = not set.

businessLineId.description: Business line the plant reports to (business_lines@1); null = not assigned.

_tableEditRevision.description: Portal table-editor revision; optional on existing documents.

updatedBy.description: Actor persons.id; no copied display name.

editHistory.description: Append-only table-edit actor, UTC time and changed field values; appended atomically with the row write.
